scripts.start: npm run export:html && cd build && open http://127.0.0.1:8080/resume.html && npx static ./build
scripts.export:pdf: npm run build && cd build && npx resume export resume.pdf --theme ../node_modules/jsonresume-theme-stackoverflow
scripts.export:html: npm run build && cd build && npx resume export resume.html --theme ../node_modules/jsonresume-theme-stackoverflow
